# NAASIFY — Full Reference

NAASIFY is a Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) marketplace. It bundles the cloud
infrastructure a product needs — hosting, databases, email, storage, domains,
compute, VPS and VPN — into one subscription, one dashboard and one bill,
instead of forcing teams to contract and reconcile nine separate vendors.

- Website: https://naasify.online/
- Support email: info@naasify.online
- Category: Backend-as-a-Service / cloud marketplace
- Payments: Paystack (card and bank transfer), in USD or NGN
- Account creation: instant, no email verification required

---

## What NAASIFY is

NAASIFY is a Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) marketplace. Instead of contracting
nine separate cloud vendors, you subscribe to the infrastructure your product
needs — hosting, databases, email, storage, domains, compute, VPS and VPN —
through one dashboard and one bill.

## Services offered

NAASIFY publishes nine core services. Each is available on its own or as part
of the All-in-One bundle:

1. Backend hosting — run and scale server-side APIs, services and workers.
2. Frontend hosting — fast hosting for static and server-rendered web apps.
3. SMTP emailing — reliable transactional and bulk email delivery.
4. Database hosting — managed databases for application data.
5. Cloud storage — object storage for files, media and backups.
6. Domain names — register and manage internet domains.
7. Cloud computing — on-demand compute for general workloads.
8. VPS (virtual private servers) — isolated servers with full control.
9. VPN — secure private networking.

## Pricing and billing

Every service is published with transparent quarterly, half-yearly and annual
plans, priced in US dollars or Nigerian naira. The All-in-One bundle stacks all
nine services into a single subscription. Current, live figures with no hidden
fees are always shown on the pricing page (https://naasify.online/pricing).

Billing cycles:
- Quarterly — 3 months.
- Half-yearly — 6 months.
- Annual — 12 months, the lowest effective rate.

You can switch cycles whenever your runway changes.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is NAASIFY?
NAASIFY is a Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) marketplace. Instead of contracting
nine separate cloud vendors, you subscribe to the infrastructure your product
needs — hosting, databases, email, storage, domains, compute, VPS and VPN —
through one dashboard and one bill.

### What cloud services does NAASIFY offer?
NAASIFY publishes nine core services: backend hosting, frontend hosting, SMTP
emailing, database hosting, cloud storage, domain names, cloud computing, VPS
(virtual private servers) and VPN. Each is available on its own or as part of
the All-in-One bundle.

### How much does NAASIFY cost?
Every service is published with transparent quarterly, half-yearly and annual
plans, priced in US dollars or Nigerian naira. The All-in-One bundle stacks all
nine services into a single subscription. See the pricing page for live, current
figures with no hidden fees.

### What billing cycles can I choose?
You can pay quarterly (3 months), half-yearly (6 months) or annually (12
months). Annual billing is the lowest effective rate, and you can switch cycles
whenever your runway changes.

### Can I pay in naira?
Yes. NAASIFY checks out with Paystack and supports both cards and bank
transfer, in USD or NGN, using a live exchange rate so the naira price is always
accurate.

### How fast are services activated?
Activation is instant. As soon as Paystack confirms your payment, your
subscription is provisioned automatically — no tickets, no sales calls, no
waiting.

### Do I need to verify my email to create an account?
No. Signing up is instant: create an account with your email and password and
you are taken straight to your dashboard, where all of your purchases and their
durations are recorded.

### How do I contact NAASIFY support?
Email info@naasify.online any time. Support is handled by real engineers —
usually within one business day — not a chatbot.
